shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I value A, B, and C equally, and this trade would only swap one equally valued good for another, leaving my variety unchanged.
I currently have equal amounts of A, B, and C, so swapping 1 B for 1 A would reduce variety by leaving me with no B and extra A, which lowers my utility.

Starting from an even 1/1/1 bundle, giving 1 B and receiving 2 A changes my inventory to A:3, B:0, C:1. I lose one unit of variety but gain a net extra good overall, and B and A are equally valued in general, so this increases my utility.
Starting from an even bundle of 1A, 1B, 1C, trading away 1C for 1B would leave me with 2B, 0C, 1A, which reduces variety and lowers my utility.

Giving 1 B and receiving 2 C changes my inventory from (1,1,1) to (0,3,1). Since all goods are equally valued and I prefer variety, this reduces variety, but the gain of one additional total unit makes the trade utility-improving overall.
Starting from an even 1-1-1 bundle, trading 1×A for 1×B would make my inventory less balanced (A:0, B:2, C:1). Since I value variety, this lowers my utility.
